protocol.advance: At least four additional strict locations across both generators, at least two more than mean log probability adds, no more than one newly flagged genuine work in each held cohort, and at least 90% candidate coverage of edited files. This research produces no authorship confidence.
protocol.comparison: First six native primary three-sentence contexts at response .50; also compare same-base mean log probability with its own genuine-work point.
protocol.development: Forty-two dated historical genuine excerpts across twenty-one work groups. Strictly exceed the second-highest assessed group maximum separately for each novel score.
protocol.hit: One location covers at least half the known edit and reaches .30 non-whitespace intersection over union.
protocol.method: Absolute mean target-token log probability difference at temperatures .7 and 1.4, minus mean expected difference under unscaled logits, divided by mean conditional standard deviation.
protocol.native: One pass over the unchanged decoded short file. Exact app-native sentence token coverage and at least twelve predicted tokens. No leading unpredicted token or text truncation.
protocol.source: First twenty-four eligible work IDs in a fixed hash order, with distinct publisher originals and common Gemini and Nano v1 polish on the same exact original sentence. Keep exact flanks; prefer one extra unchanged sentence on a hash-assigned side when supported.
